title: Taste of Banff Food Tour
blurb:
Experience Banff with all your senses on the town’s original —and most delicious —walking food tour through one of Canada’s most breathtaking mountain destinations.

Stroll the streets like a local alongside Joanna... your local, Banff guide with years of food tour experience. We will be stopping at a variety of handpicked eateries to sample some of the best of what Banff has to offer. 

But our tours are about more than just great bites... they are also a journey through the stories, history, and culture that make Banff so special.

On the Taste of Banff food tour, you’ll uncover hidden gems, taste local favourites, and see a side of Banff most visitors miss.
